name: Nehemiah
summary: Nehemiah son of Hachaliah served King Artaxerxes in Shushan the palace. When he heard that the wall of Jerusalem was broken down, he went there as governor and led the people to build it again.

key_moments.title: Weeping for Jerusalem
key_moments.description: In Shushan the palace, Nehemiah heard that the people left in Judah were in great trouble and the wall of Jerusalem was broken down. For days he wept, mourned and fasted, and he prayed to the God of heaven.

key_moments.title: Asks the King to Send Him
key_moments.description: As he served wine to King Artaxerxes, the king saw that he was sad and asked what he wanted. Nehemiah prayed, then asked to be sent to build the city, and the king gave him letters and timber.

key_moments.title: Finishes the Wall in Fifty-Two Days
key_moments.description: The builders completed the wall in fifty-two days. When their enemies heard of it, they lost heart, for they saw that God had done this work.

key_moments.title: Tells the People Not to Mourn
key_moments.description: When the people wept at hearing the law, Nehemiah, Ezra and the Levites told them not to mourn, for the day was holy to the LORD. They were sent to feast and share, for gladness in the LORD would be their strength.
